reviews.comment: I dreadfully took this class as my upper level history for education, but Dr. B is AMAZING!  You HAVE to put in the work and it's lecture heavy, but every lecture feels like a comedy show.  As a future teacher, he is an example of what I want to be like; someone who makes a class that seems dreadful one that students look forward to.

WOW.I took this class as my one upper-level History credit for Education, and I was definitely intimidated by it at first.He truly loves his job, and it is such a joy to learn from him. I would take a class from him again in a heartbeat if I could fit it into my degree plan. He truly wants you to learn and will help you in every way possible.
A very interested and immersed professor, with a lot of passion not only for what he's teaching, but for who he's teaching.

Really good professor. I understood what was expected of me and he provided great guidance. The best history prof in the department. I took three classes with him and learned a lot while enjoying my time. Keep in mind that I am not a history nerd but he made it very enjoyable. Also, don't use your phone in class as it distracts him lol.

Second class I've had with Dr.B, he is a one-of-a-kind prof. His lectures are so enjoyable to listen to and he makes extremely complex things exciting and understandable. Also do not be fooled by his humor is a leading expert in his field, he is wildly intelligent about the classes he teaches.

Dr. B is one of the best professors I have ever had, the kind that you are going to remember for the rest of your life. He is hilarious and talks to his students and tells stories. He genuinely wants our feedback on the course to make it helpful for us instead of just doing what he wants. The material is extensive but he sets you up for success

So happy I chose Dr. Brunstedt for my capstone course. The class was super intimate and relaxed, Dr. B is great with building your final research paper up as the course goes. Participation is key, because it only helps you write your paper as you complete each assignment. Dr. B. is funny, engaging, cares about his students' success.

Dr. B is the best. Tons of pop culture references. He is one of the most knowledgeable profs I have had at A&M. Lectures are slide-heavy, but the important stuff is easy to identify. The class covers a thousand years of EE History.... so you're either going to love the material or hate it. Dr. B makes sure you learn it.

You can skip purchasing the textbook; only one mandatory book is essential for your paper. Success in tests relies on thorough lecture notes. The professor's captivating lectures make note-taking enjoyable, and he's lenient on the big essay grade. Tests may be challenging but are very manageable. Awesome professor and interesting course.

Professor Brunstedt is probably one of my favourite professors at Texas A&M. While lecture attendance is mandatory, I think if you skip, you're missing out on a lot of entertaining but also well-presented and interesting content, so make sure to attend.

Dr. B is fantastic. He is funny and engaging. He does expect his students to be serious and focus on the material. My only complaint is this course is front-heavy. There is alot of reading and writing the first half of this course. The material is graduate-level material and is super dense, but do the writings and you will be rewarded.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: Along with everything the others reviewers said,one of the best things about Dr. B is how there is no right way to do things. He is normal and real and wants to collab with students. Makes students feel smart just by discussing ideas. Even though he has so much knowledge,he wants to hear student ideas and makes them feel wnted in class. Great prof.

Outstanding professor! So interesting, engaging, and knowledgable about every question you ask. Welcomes true discussion. Class can be a lot of work, but lots of room to preform how you hope. Great structure and just 100/10 reccomend

Dr. Brunstedt ensures that his lecture hall has a light and friendly environment. While attendance is mandatory I wouldn't have missed his classes for the world. I looked forward to hearing him lecture about history. You could tell that he was very passionate and it reflected in his students. I was so impressed I signed up to RMP to rate him.

Best lecturer I've had as a history major. He keeps the class light and casual, and while he covers a lot of material at once, he posts his PowerPoint beforehand so it's easy to follow along. If you do the study guide his tests are a breeze, but only IF YOU DO THE STUDY GUIDE.

Brunstedt is so funny, has such a passion for history, and is pretty easy going. First half of the class was a challenge for me as we read chapters/articles and wrote responses, but second half was more project based. Just depends on what you like. You have to participate in discussion at least once. I would take this professor again!
The class was very fun. If he teaches it again I would recommend.

Dr. Brunstedt was fantastic. Really great lectures, this man loves history and it shows. I can't wait to get another course with him. Tests weren't too difficult, just make sure you study and don't cram at the last second.

Brunstedt is a great lecturer! He really loves history and is good about explaining it in a thoughtful and interesting way, and is kind of a chaotic/hyper sort of hilarious. There was a textbook, but if you take good notes in lecture, you don't really need it. He's honestly a very generous grader, like curves tests and isn't too hard on essays.

If you have the option to take Professor Brunstedt, DO IT! This guy is the most hilarious professor on campus. I'll warn you, that on the first day of class he runs through the syllabus and makes the class sound like it is the hardest to ever exist. IT'S NOT! He makes it so fun! This was my first class at TAMU that I looked forward to every day!

3 tests weighed 80% of the grade, but they weren't difficult. He was knowledgeable about the history behind the events, which, at first, made me wonder if it was significant. Ultimately, just have to remember the dates and content from the lecture slides. The textbook wasn't necessary, and extra credit opportunities were given. Attendance graded.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I have a deep hatred for history classes in general, but Jonathan made the classes interesting, even if it was lots of note-taking. But that's about it: note-taking. This class is simply using those notes to take 2 exams and a final with "attendance quizzes" which are freebies for showing up. He's also hilarious and talks to his students. Amazing!

Overall he teaches well. But be warned that he is a European History professor, not a general history professor. That being said, this course: HIST 102 "Western Civilization since 1600" had no American History only European history. Take this into consideration when considering his courses.
Fantastic professor who genuinely cares about his students, one of the better lecturers I've had at A&M as well. I highly recommend any course taught by Prof. Brunstedt, it'll be worth your time.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: Do not listen to the one bad review of prof B. He is the best, most respectable professor I have ever had in my 4 years at this university. As a graduating senior he did literally everything in his power to help me succeed and move to the real world. Go to class, study hard and you will learn more from him than you have from any other professor.

LOVE THIS CLASS! I have gone to Texas A&M for 4 years now, and this is easily the most enjoyable class I have taken. I honestly wish this was not my last semester at this university because I would love to take another class with him. He is a comical genius. Go to class, take notes, and STUDY DATES (even if he says to not worry about it)!

The class isnt a super easy A, but youll actually learn. Feels like he wants you to get the best grade you can and will offer extra credit if you ask and are willing to do it. Great, entertaining lectures. 10/10 would take again.
One of the best professors I have had the pleasure of taking! Lectures are amazing, and funny! Very passionate about what he teaches and it shows.

Dr. B is THE gem of A&Ms History Department. I absolutely loved his lectures, and he always ended them with cliffhangers that had you wanting more. Attendance is taken, but its worth going to class anyway. The tests are a mix of mc and short answer (be prepared to remember dates). Overall, Dr. B is inspiring and he really cares about students!
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Lots of reading but the books are actually good, especially Under a Cruel Star. I struggled w/ understanding the format for papers on the books but Dr. B worked with me. I found Dr.B to be very flexible, understanding and fair despite my very busy schedule, he worked with me to help me succeed. Communication is key and Dr. B is always accessible
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Brunstedt is the best professor I've taken at A&M. It is not an easy A but if you show up to class, and put some effort in, you'll get an A or a B. His lectures are amazing and interesting. He is really caring and is passionate about teaching. He was easy to talk to via person or email. If you have an opportunity to take him do it!

Here's the thing, if you are a history major, your will love his class. Any other majors steer clear of this prof. Hard grader on papers. You will have 2 tests, 1 paper (option of 3 different books and prompts), 2 map quizzes (easy), & attendance. He is not a prof that will be able to help with extra questions, I emailed him constantly & got zero
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Fantastic professor, each lecture was well thought out and very interesting
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Brunstedt is a great professor! Gives extra credit opportunities and is very accessible to answer questions outside of class. Great lecturer and seems truly passionate about the subject matter. Textbook not necessary as his lectures cover what you need for the test. He does not make things harder than they need to be and is very understanding.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Brunstedt is by far the best professor I have taken. I took his Soviet Union class and loved every minute of it. There is also tons of extra credit opportunity and if you show up to class and pay attention the tests are pretty easy. He is also hilarious and has some great stories. I 100% recommend taking him.

I took Dr. Brunstedt's Soviet Union class. As a finance major, this is an elective I went out of my way to take - and I'm SO glad I did! He is a gem. He makes class so interesting, cares deeply about his students, and offers extra credit! Take his class!!!

Class and prof were really great. Attendance was mandatory and laptops were not allowed, which was a bit frustrating. However the lectures were always very insightful and entertaining. Would take again without doubt.
